# Agenda 0.10.0
Agenda is now open source under the GPL: https://github.com/willschulz/agenda
- Edit your board's rows: Settings → Edit Rows lets you rename, add, reorder, and delete rows. Deleting a row asks which row its projects should move to. - New boards open a short welcome tour and start with Correspondence, Life Stuff, and Work Miscellany in Top of Mind. - Usage-limit dials show how fast you're using your Claude and Cursor subscription limits, for whichever tools you use. - AI usage now shows each project's share by tool. You can also record what you pay for each tool and see that cost split across projects. - Search finds todos by task number (#123 or 123). - Clicking a todo's hover number copies its #id and short title. - Hovering the right side of the gap between two todos inserts a subtask under the todo above. - Removes the agent-pickup and lookup copy buttons from todo cards. - Before an update changes your database's structure, Agenda now saves a backup of it first. This update does that once, when it converts your rows to the new editable format.

# Agenda 0.9.0
- Uses a rounded Mac app icon in the Dock and Finder. - Adds a Recents menu for recently touched todos. - Shows a todo's id above its title on hover. - Evens out spacing between single-line and multi-line titles. - Keeps lab-note links readable in dark mode. - Opens note links in Chrome. - Moves Add todo into each project card, inserts a new todo at the top of its group, and lets you insert one between existing tasks. - Keeps the new-todo field focused after you add a task, and types into search when the board is filtered. - Fixes a freeze after rearranging tasks and lag after status clicks.

# Agenda 0.8.0
- Adds a past-day accomplishments view to the header timeline. - Keeps the overview intentionally compact: project names plus task and point counts. - Expands each project on click to show its exact completed tasks. - Supports internal scrolling for long accomplishment days. - Improves Agenda Pulse placement and gives stale items a distinct yellow treatment. - Uses a standard gear icon for Settings.
